title: Gorgeous 5BR 30A Beach Home with a Shared Pool
meta_description: Stay at Grayt Tides, a gorgeous 5BR, 3.5BA vacation home on 30A, with a full kitchen, a balcony, a large porch, and a communal pool. Sleeps 12 guests.
description_expanded: This vacation home is located in The Preserve at Grayton and has 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. The home features stunning 10' ceilings throughout. Find yourself surrounded by towering palms and pines, this gorgeous beach home beckons you to experience bright spaces, designer touches, and amazing community amenities.As you walk in to the home you'll find 3 of the home's bedrooms. Walking up the stairs is the main open concept area with living, dining and kitchen combined. The living area features a comfortable sectional. There is dining at the table for 8 with additional seating at the kitchen island and more out on the balcony. Off the kitchen is a convenient powder room plus the master suite. Head up to the 3rd floor to find the 5th bedroom. A private oasis where you'll feel like you're up in the trees.Laze away the day on a spacious porch, hang out by the pool, or go for a bike ride in this immensely pedestrian and bike friendly community. Grayt Tides is located on the quiet west end of the eclectic 30A. It’s close to Blue Mountain Beach and the famous and delectable Blue Mountain Creamery. It is also located just 3 miles from Seaside and super close to hot spots like The Red Bar and Pandora’s.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, TV. Jack-n-Jill bathroom with Bedroom 2.1st Floor, Bedroom 2: Twin-over-twin bunk bed with Twin trundle and TV.1st Floor, Bedroom 3: Triple twin bunk and twin bed. Private bathroom.2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed with TV, private bathroom and private balcony access.3rd Floor, Bedroom 5: King bed with TV, wet bar, private bathroom and balcony access.Beach Access:Exit the neighborhood and cross 30A. To the west of Sanctuary by The Sea complex you'll find your gated walkway to the beach. Once down the pathway, head right towards the public beach or on your left past the sections of private beach you'll find Grayton Beach State Park.Preserve at Grayton Beach:The Preserve at Grayton Beach is an ultra-exclusive and gated community right on Scenic 30A. This neighborhood features custom built beach-chic homes with state-of-the-art amenities and inclusions. In one of these meticulously appointed homes, you’ll find yourself surrounded by one-of-a-kind beauty that is unsurpassed in every sense. Enjoy 2 community pools (1 heated seasonally) and tennis courts. The location puts you within walking or biking distance from all the area's popular spots. From ice cream to shopping, you'll find it in the Grayton Beach and Blue Mountain Beach areas.Your stay at Grayt Tides comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 2 cars* Sorry, no pets allowed.* No golf carts or trailers allowed in the Preserve at GraytonAn initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
